clusters.headline: Tamil Nadu Faces Legal Scrutiny Over Karthigai Deepam Ritual Dispute
aiSummaryBullets: The Madurai District Collector issued an apology to the Supreme Court for failing to light the ritual lamp at the Deepathoon pillar as previously ordered.
Legal disputes persist regarding the site of the Karthigai Deepam lighting, involving deliberations between the Madras High Court and Supreme Court.

clusters.headline: Samajwadi Party And Congress Clash Over Uttar Pradesh Seat Sharing

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Sets Guidelines On Bail And Reviews Legal Petitions
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court ruled that individuals with prior criminal convictions cannot be granted bail solely based on the right to a speedy trial.
Judges have requested police input regarding interim bail applications related to the 2020 Delhi riots case.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Denies Interim Bail To Sharjeel Imam And Umar Khalid
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court of India rejected the requests for interim bail filed by activists Sharjeel Imam and Umar Khalid.
Judges directed the Delhi Police to file a response regarding the activists' petitions in their respective UAPA cases.
